# Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

Install packages if you don't have them:

```{r install-packages, eval=FALSE}
install.packages(c("DAAG", "leaps"))
```

```{r load-packages}
library(DAAG)
library(leaps)
```

# Data preparation

Read the CSV and drop rows with any missing value.

```{r read-data}
df.raw <- read.csv("Life Expectancy Data.csv")
df <- na.omit(df.raw)
```

Log-transform the right-skewed variables, then drop redundant or unusable columns.

```{r transform-and-drop}
log_cols <- c(
  "thinness.5.9.years",
  "thinness.1.19.years",
  "Population",
  "GDP",
  "HIV.AIDS",
  "under.five.deaths",
  "Measles",
  "percentage.expenditure",
  "infant.deaths"
)
for (col in log_cols) {
  df[[col]] <- log1p(df[[col]])
}

drop_cols <- c(
  "Country",              
  "infant.deaths",        
  "percentage.expenditure",
  "thinness.5.9.years"    
)
df[drop_cols] <- NULL
```

Note: `na.omit()` was already applied above, so no further filtering is needed here.

```{r numeric-cols}
(df.numeric <- df[, sapply(df, is.numeric)])
```

# Predictor scatterplots

```{r scatterplots}
lapply(names(df.numeric), function(column_name) {
  plot(df.numeric[[column_name]],
       df$Life.expectancy,
       xlab = column_name,
       ylab = "Life Expectancy")
})
```

No rows were removed manually — influential-point screening is done after fitting (see Diagnostics).

# Training and test split

```{r split}
set.seed(67)

n        <- nrow(df)
train_idx <- sample(n, size = floor(0.7 * n))
train_df  <- df[train_idx, ]
test_df   <- df[-train_idx, ]
```

# Model fitting

## Full model (all predictors)

```{r full-model}
lm.full <- lm(Life.expectancy ~ ., data = train_df)
summary(lm.full)
```

## Optimised model (backward stepwise selection)

```{r step-model}
lm.opt <- step(lm.full, direction = "backward")
summary(lm.opt)
```

# Diagnostics

We go with `lm.opt`.

```{r diagnostic-plots}
## Four standard plots: Resid vs Fitted, Q-Q, Scale-Location, Resid vs Leverage
plot(lm.opt, main = "Optimised Model")

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
hist(lm.opt$residuals, main = "Residual Histogram", xlab = "Residuals of lm.opt")
```

Flag potential outliers / influential points on three criteria: leverage (`hatvalues`), studentised residuals (`rstudent`), and Cook's distance.

```{r influence-check}
n_obs <- nobs(lm.opt)
p     <- length(coef(lm.opt))

flag <- data.frame(
  hat  = hatvalues(lm.opt)      > 2 * p / n_obs,
  rstu = abs(rstudent(lm.opt))  > 3,
  cook = cooks.distance(lm.opt) > 4 / n_obs
)

## Points flagged on all three criteria
which(rowSums(flag) == 3)

colSums(flag)
```

No outlier / influential points.

# Model evaluation (PRESS and RMSEP)

```{r}
model.arena <- list(lm.opt = lm.opt, lm.full = lm.full)
model.comp  <- data.frame()

for (name in names(model.arena)) {
  model <- model.arena[[name]]
  model.comp[name, "PRESS"] <- press(model)
  model.comp[name, "RMSE"]  <- sqrt(sum(residuals(model)^2) / nobs(model))
}
model.comp
```
